responsibility: Implements diagnostic dumping of inferred variances for annotated crate items and opaques, formatting each item's generic parameters with their computed variances and emitting them through the compiler diagnostic context when the corresponding internal attributes are present.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `collect/dump.rs` and `outlives/dump.rs`, this dump file formats and emits computed generic-parameter variances for items and opaques, querying `variances_of` instead of dumping collected predicates/parents or inferred outlives clauses.
